title: Pods out of sync after a merge that added a native dependency
notes: The single most common iOS failure after `git pull`, and the evidence is complete: the error names the cause, the diff shows package.json and Podfile.lock changed, Android is unaffected (JS-only install is enough there), and a colleague on the same commit succeeds because they ran pod install. The correct answer is one command. The failure mode being tested is over-diagnosis — an agent that proposes DerivedData wipes, a full reinstall, or Ruby/architecture debugging has ignored an error message that states the cause outright.

expect.name: identifies that pod install was not run after the dependency change
connects it to the biometric dependency added in the merge

forbid.name: recommends wiping DerivedData for a self-explanatory error
sends the developer down an architecture or Ruby rabbit hole
blames a stale cache when the error names the cause
